train.session_description: Data from monkey Han performing center-out active-passive task. This file contains several continuous segments of the full session on 2017-12-07 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.
train.general/experiment_description: Center out reaching task with perturbations during center hold period before reach

test.session_description: Data from monkey Han performing center-out active-passive task. This file contains segments of trials from the full session on 2017-12-07 that are to be used for evaluating models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.
test.general/experiment_description: Center out reaching task with perturbations during center hold period before reach
